decision: Retain one cached native accessibility Connection for the exact GetAddress value. Keep the std mutex only around clone/publication, never across I/O. Concurrent misses return one published winner and drop unused temporary connections. Discover application PID/unique owner and focused field afresh after every cache lookup; retain independent field/token/focus/lease/layout/epoch checks in each binding. On disconnected socket I/O, evict only that same cached connection; a delayed failure from an old transport cannot clear its successor. Return the existing error with no retry or mutation fallback. No word, document, privacy or edit grant is cached.
